studies.label: Protrusions to enclosure — can protrusion mechanics reach stable wrapping?

nodes.label: Differential adhesion alone drives stable enclosure in a well-defined mechani...
nodes.statement: Differential adhesion alone drives stable enclosure in a well-defined mechanical regime: the adhesion x symbiont-surface-tension phase diagram shows a sharp transition tracking J_hs = J_sM - J_hM, with stable enclosure, partial wrapping, transient internalization, and no enclosure as distinct regimes.
